title: Platen Micro-Fluidic Nip Impression
discipline: Platen Press Micro-Fluidics · Ink Squash (Quetschrand) · Cotton Paper Elastoplasticity · Letterpress Tactile Deboss
hypothesis: Can digital typography simulate the micro-fluidic shearing and elastoplastic paper deboss of a letterpress platen impression, demonstrating that increasing impression pressure (5–30 MPa) forces high-viscosity ink outward into an authentic microscopic 'ink squash' halo rim (Quetschrand) while embossing paper fibers into permanent tactile relief?
